summary: 'Weight and Capacity' develops mathematical reasoning and application through the chapter 'Weight and Capacity'. The main learning is organised around the source-supported points below.
key_points: Anu has recorded the weights of the items in her house.
Check if she has recorded them correctly by putting a tick against them if they look correct.
Refrigerator – 50 g Let Us Do Read the scales.

Help learners to make sense of each of the scales and make them understand how the ‘0’ works in each scale.
